# Expected changes for CAMP Revision Update (Patch 62 / Season22) on September 2nd, 2025

![Expected changes for CAMP Revision Update (Patch 62 / Season22) on September 2nd, 2025](/uploads/550_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Once again, the next content update is just around the corner. The current PTS is coming to an end and there are numerous changes again, which I will now present in more detail here today. On September 2nd, 2025** the update will be published under the name “**C.A.M.P. Revision**”. As a result, Season 21 ends and **Season 22: Appalachian Modern Living** begins.

### Index

## C.A.M.P. Construction menu overhaul

The CAMP build menu is a central focus of this update. The CAMP construction menu has become increasingly confusing over the years and you sometimes had to search for a long time until you found certain items. That has now changed.

The new CAMP construction menu is restructured and combines suitable elements into clear areas. This means you can find the items you are looking for much more quickly.

Furthermore, the placement rules for all items have been made 100% flexible. If you set the workshop building rules to "Relaxed"** in the **game settings, the new rules will be active. You now have the option to choose for yourself whether you want to **snap** the objects normally, whether you want them to **collide** or whether you just want to place them completely **freely**. When we say “completely free” placement we really mean free placement. You can place objects inside each other or simply in the air. Everything that previously required various tricks such as “merge” glitches is now possible with the built-in tools.

With these new tools you can really easily build great creative CAMPs. I'm really excited to see what kind of CAMPs the community will come up with.

## Changed perk cards

Perk cards change again. Many of them are fundamental in their function. However, we have now gone through all areas, which means there shouldn't be many new fundamental changes in the near future. **In this update, the perk cards for heavy weapons, bows and melee combat have been adjusted.**

An important change is e.g. the perk card “Tank Killer”, this now only requires 2 ranks and applies to all ranged weapons, including heavy weapons.
